name: Window Management & Control Suite
description: Native Win32 and cross-platform window enumeration, handle search, activation, close, visibility check, positioning, resizing, caption modification, and toast notifications

ActiveWindow.description: Bring target window to foreground and set as active state

CloseWindow.description: Send close signal (WM_CLOSE) to target window with timeout and force termination options

EnumWindows.description: Traverse system visible/top-level windows and return handle list

FindWindow.description: Search window handle by title, class name, or process name

FlashWindow.description: Flash window in taskbar or highlight border to attract user attention

GetWindowCaption.description: Retrieve current title bar text of specified target window

SetWindowCaption.description: Update and set specified target window title bar to new text

GetWindowInfo.description: Query and return complete window metadata including handle, title, class, PID, process name, bounds, and state

GetWindowPoint.description: Calculate absolute screen pixel coordinates relative to window anchor orientation and offset

IsWindowExists.description: Lightweight check if specified window exists in the operating system

IsWindowVisible.description: Lightweight check if specified window is currently visible on screen

MessageBox.description: Display a desktop dialog box with custom message text and buttons

NotifyMessage.description: Pop up native desktop toast notification bubble

SetWindowGeometry.description: Atomically update window location (X, Y) and size (Width, Height) in a single system call (-1 keeps dimension)

SetWindowState.description: Control window show, hide, maximize, minimize, or restore state

SetWindowZOrder.description: Pin window to TopMost display level, remove pin state, or adjust Z-order

WaitWindow.description: Wait until target window appears, disappears, or becomes active foreground

WindowAncestor.description: Retrieve parent or root owner window for target child window
